description_en: Resets cloud desktops in a shared cloud desktop group
description_zh: 重置共享型云电脑内的云电脑
kebab_example: aliyun ecd reset-desktops --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --desktop-group-id dg-07if7qsxoxkb60000 --pay-type PrePaid --reset-type 1 --image-id m-4zfb6zj728hhr0000 --desktop-id ecd-07if7qsxoxkb30000 --desktop-group-ids dg-kadkdfaf0000 --reset-scope ALL --last-retry-time 1 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ResetDesktops

parameters.description_en: The region ID. Call [DescribeRegions](~~196646~~) to list regions that support WUYING Workspace.
parameters.description_zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~196646~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表。
parameters.help_en: The region ID. Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html to list regions that support WUYING Workspace
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the shared cloud desktop.

- If you specify `DesktopId`, the system ignores `DesktopGroupId`.

- If `DesktopId` is empty, the system uses `DesktopGroupId` to retrieve the `DesktopId` of all cloud desktops in the shared cloud desktop group.
parameters.description_zh:
共享型云电脑ID。

- 如果传入了`DesktopId`，则忽略该`DesktopGroupId`。
- 如果`DesktopId`为空，则会根据`DesktopGroupId`去获取该共享型云电脑内所有云电脑的`DesktopId`。
parameters.help_en:
The ID of the shared cloud desktop.

parameters.help_zh:

parameters.name: desktop_group_id

parameters.description_en:
The billing method.

> This parameter applies only when resetting shared cloud desktops. If you leave it empty, the system resets all cloud desktops in the shared cloud desktop group, regardless of their billing method.
parameters.description_zh:
付费类型。
> 仅对重置共享型云电脑有效，为空则重置共享型云电脑下所有付费类型的云电脑。

parameters.name: pay_type

parameters.description_en: The reset type. This determines whether to reset and which disks to reset.
parameters.description_zh: 重置类型，决定是否重置，以及要重置的磁盘范围。

parameters.help_zh: 重置类型，决定是否重置，以及要重置的磁盘范围

parameters.description_en: A list of cloud desktop IDs. You can specify 1 to 100 IDs.
parameters.description_zh: 云电脑 ID 列表。可设置 1~100 个。
parameters.help_en: A list of cloud desktop IDs. You can specify 1 to 100 IDs
parameters.help_zh: 云电脑 ID 列表。可设置 1~100 个
